title: Strikeforce Morituri #3 #4 #5 Lot Marvel 1987 Peter B Gillis Brent Anderson
condition_description: All three bright with light handling wear; light toning on the back covers. See photos.
description:
Strikeforce: Morituri #3, #4 and #5 (February - April 1987), Marvel Comics - "We Who Are About to Die." Peter B. Gillis story, Brent Anderson art. 75 cent cover price each.

- #3: Marvel 25th Anniversary corner box. Back cover: Brach's Gum Dinger Gumby and Pokey ad
- #4: "The Party's Over". Back cover: Brach's Gum Dinger Gumby and Pokey ad
- #5: Anderson/Williams cover. Back cover: TSR Advanced Marvel Super Heroes game ad

Condition: all three bright with light handling wear; light toning on the back covers (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
